obligation: Preserve abstract function/external reference nullability in signatures, globals/tables, constants, non-defaultable locals and typed embedding/host boundaries.
representation: WasmType::Reference owns kind and nullable flag; FUNCREF/EXTERNREF/FUNC/EXTERN are named projections of that representation. Supported parser heap kinds remain function/external, preserving their nullability; concrete/GC/shared kinds are rejected rather than erased. reference_type, is_subtype_of, default_value and WasmValue::fits_type serve the semantic operations. Values retain existing FuncRef/ExternRef Value payloads; null rejection derives from the actual value and expected type. Constant ref.func is statically non-null; expression validation uses subtype compatibility and evaluation checks actual values. Defaultable locals alone receive residual defaults; non-defaultable locals remain in the shared frame uninitialized state until validated assignment. Immutable global import types covary, mutable types remain invariant. Runtime and host argument/result checks share value compatibility plus existing reference ownership validation. No opcode, Value/cell kind, execution core or residual format added.
scope: Prior exact 210-file affected decoded-module inventory; prior 3289 scalar/vector/resource/call/root directives plus 21 new nullability directives. No full pinned suite or Test262 replay; OXC semantics/dispatch are unchanged.

controls.obligations: Non-null abstract func globals/table initializers and parameters; initialized non-defaultable func/extern locals; non-null external parameter/result values; nullable null remains accepted; immutable non-null func global imported as nullable without losing original resource; mutable-kind/type mismatch remains a link error. Previous numeric/resource/identity/ABI controls retain all passes.

checks.internal_obligations: Existing typed host/root lease regression uses non-null function/external signatures and covers null argument rejection, null host result rejection, stale roots, wrong kind/arity, active program/native/call-root restoration, collection and release. Null-test positions derive from argument values rather than a second argument layout. No ordinary conformance unit is added; existing nullable table/reference ownership controls remain.

oracle.qualification: All 20 new local Node observations agree: 17 values, two non-null external null-argument TypeErrors and one immutable-to-mutable import LinkError. Earlier six callable-type Node discrepancies remain recorded in task37-wasm-callable-types.json; this does not claim that they disappeared or that all Wasm behavior matches Node.

limitations: Abstract function/external nullability is qualified. Concrete type/GC reference families, canonical type context at value/resource boundaries, ref.as_non_null/typed branches/calls/tail calls, GC objects/operators, shared resources and exceptions remain open. The affected scope still has 938 failures, not a global remaining-failure census. Non-defaultable initialization relies on the existing frontend validator; low-level Rust lowering consumes validated bodies. Stage A cutover/cleanup/full three-suite qualification remains open. No performance claim.
